content:
I'm grateful for the professional development stipend at ClickUp. It is a huge perk to work for a company that genuinely invests in our growth.

I used some of the funds this year to dive into the StackOptimise ⚙️ GTM Engineering course.

I recommend it to other SDR Leaders looking for a technical breakdown of the end to end process, from building signal-based lead lists to landing the meeting with effective messaging at scale. It gave me a much better perspective on how to orchestrate tools like Clay and Make to automate so our reps can focus on higher-quality conversations.

Lucky to have a talented demand team (s/o Sai David Kyle Andy Vasu Katherine) already doing the heavy lifting, but it feels good to speak their language a bit better now.  Looking forward to getting into the weeds with the team and applying what I learned.

And thanks to Felix Frank and Penn Frank for putting together such tactical content!
businessSignal: Investment in Employee Development and Tech Innovation

Excited to share what the team has been building with our new ClickUp Super Agents.

Most AI feels like a tool you visit.
 
ClickUp Super Agents feel like teammates you work with.
 
They:
▪️ Live inside your ClickUp workspace
▪️ Use tasks to track their work
▪️ Retain context across docs, tasks, and decisions
▪️ Run continuously in the background on triggers, schedules, and signals from your work
 
You lead. Your Super Agents go to work.
 
Launch video below if you want to see how it all comes together.
keyTakeaway: The target company is investing in AI technology to enhance workflow efficiency, presenting an opportunity to offer complementary solutions or services.

If you’re interested or want to hear more, shoot me a message.
